title: eng-infra
text:
eng-infra

Hana Park: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/9582 - scheduler change + eviction header tweak. Need runtime + security eyes before merge. cc @Sasha @Jules

Mike Chen: quick q — does this touch any public API or just internal allocators?

Hana Park: internal only (slot allocator + cluster header). No consumer API changes. main risk is rolling canary and header format for eviction.

Sasha Iyer: I'll take a look today. Primary concern is the new async slot release path. Did you run integration with dyn-batch turned on?

Hana Park: yes, ran local e2e with dyn-batch on and a small canary on staging. logs looked clean but want runtime perf signoff. snippet of changed files:
```
- runtime/scheduler/slot_allocator.py
- infra/headers/eviction_header.yaml
- infra/deploy/canary-config.yaml
```

Tim O'Neill: infra-wise looks fine from my side — the canary-config is ok for a 10% traffic slice. I'll coordinate the canary window if runtime gives thumbs.

Sasha Iyer: one nit in slot_allocator: race condition if release() triggered during schedule loop. small fix suggested inline. Will leave an approval after that patch.

Hana Park: pushed fix per review comment, new commit at HEAD. also added a short comment explaining the backoff choice.

InfraBot: CI status: ci/unit — passed, ci/integration — passed, ci/canary-check — queued

Jules - Security: quick read — eviction header change adds an additional unsigned metadata field (evict-src). Need a short note on threat model and whether we need to sign that header. Can you add a comment in the PR explaining why unsigned is ok?

Hana Park: will add a security note in PR description and link to the design doc. also can add HMAC if you want — would prefer to avoid for perf but can do if required.

Sasha Iyer: after the doc + tiny race fix I'm fine to approve. then runtime canary for 30m on dedicated and we can promote.

Jules - Security: add the doc + reason (perf tradeoff) and I'll do a security approval today. If you add a short test asserting header parsing rejects malformed evict-src, that helps.

Hana Park: noted — adding test and doc link now. ETA ~30m.

Mike Chen: timeline — do we need to wait for business hours? can we do rolling promote tonight?

Tim O'Neill: Ops prefers daytime window but given it's low-risk we can promote in the next 3 hours if security approves.

Hana Park: ok targeting merge in ~2.5h assuming approvals. tagging this for runtime, security, infra final checks. :thumbsup:

Sasha Iyer: thanks — will re-review once tests + doc are in.

Jules - Security: I'll check after you push the doc.

InfraBot: Deploy window requested by @Hana Park for canary: 2026-03-17 15:00 UTC (pending approvals)
